geval_effect.reading: A gate is useful only if it holds wrong decisions clearly more often than right ones. G-Eval is a model judging explanations, not ground truth.

notes: Rates come from a sample enriched with attacks and cover a few dozen transactions; the confidence intervals are wide and say so.
Money uses the ASSUMPTIONS above. Token counts, decisions and missed value are measured.
The answer key marks every generator-planted transaction, including early ones nothing could know yet, so recall below 100% is expected.
